issues.detail: The skill does not explicitly cover error handling or edge cases such as missing registry or invalid digests.
The instructions contain verbose explanations that could be trimmed for brevity.
The installation instructions assume macOS (brew) or Linux, which may not apply to all environments.

scenarios.name: keyless-sign-ci
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies all rubric requirements, while Response A does not use a digest or the required verify flags.

scenarios.name: sbom-attestation
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies the rubric with all required cosign commands and verification details, while Response B is incomplete and does not provide the necessary commands.

scenarios.name: enforce-signed-images-kyverno
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies the rubric with a Kyverno ClusterPolicy, Enforce action, Pod match, imageReferences, and keyless attestor; Response B does not provide a Kyverno policy and thus fails the rubric.
